perRequirement.imageRegion: All three seed rows; central flame body and surrounding receiver region.
perRequirement.observation: Reviewed all 24 Beauty images (3 seed rows x 8 frames). In every seed row, frame 1 shows the starting flame; frames 21, 60, 120, and 180 show a sustained, visibly varying flame; frame 240 shows extinction or a diminished stopping state; and frames 300 and 360 show a clean idle state. The depicted flame lifecycle is complete and visually coherent.
